title: Pelican Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Situated in a prime location, this vacation home offers easy access to a variety of dining options. From upscale fine dining to quirky eateries with live jazz at The Red Bar in Grayton Beach, there's something for every palate. You'll also find charming shops, outdoor dining venues, and Sunday night concerts on the green within walking distance. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a challenging round of golf and stunning gulf views at the nearby Santa Rosa Golf and Beach Club. Plus, with 18 miles of scenic bike paths, staying active becomes an enjoyable adventure. If you're in the mood for some retail therapy, the renowned designer mall in Sandestin is just a short ten-minute drive away. Step inside this Florida Cottage-style home to discover its delightful features, including clapboard siding, a tin roof, and four covered porches. Savor your morning coffee while enjoying gentle sea breezes on the private porches of each bedroom or the living area. With sleeping accommodations for up to 13 guests, this cottage is perfect for families or groups of friends. The first floor boasts a queen bedroom and a sleeper sofa in the living area, while the second floor offers a king bedroom with a private bath, a queen bedroom, and another queen bedroom that shares a guest bathroom. The third-floor loft provides additional sleeping space with a set of bunks and a twin daybed.
rooms_guidance: Loft: Single Over Single Bunk + Twin
